messages:
Kelsey Harper: Hey team — quick heads up, my last day is Friday 2026-04-02. A few last-week logistics I want to confirm: COBRA signup timeline and link, PTO payout timing, laptop return address + golden image wipe, transfer/cancel Adobe & Figma licenses, and when SSO/access will be cut. @Marta can you advise?

Marta (People Ops): Congrats on the new role, Kelsey! :party_parrot: We'll walk through. Short answers: COBRA window = 60 days from coverage loss, benefits end = last day of this month (4/30) unless you elect COBRA earlier, payroll will include PTO payout on next monthly run (we'll confirm exact date). I'll DM the COBRA link and the benefits FAQ.

Kelsey Harper: Thanks. Is COBRA sign-up online or paper? Any docs I should expect?

Marta (People Ops): Online via our benefits portal — link: https://benefits.redwood.example/portal (I'll DM secure invite). You'll get an email from "Redwood Benefits" with a unique enrollment link. Keep an eye on spam.

Alex (IT): For laptop return: Please back up personal files, sign out of iCloud/Google, then drop off or ship using pre-paid label we provide. We can schedule a FedEx pickup if needed.

Alex (IT): Return address / drop-off:
```
Redwood Inference IT Returns
Attn: Asset Returns
1200 Inference Way, Suite 400
San Francisco, CA 94107
```

Kelsey Harper: Can you generate the label and DM? I won't be in SF Fri but can ship from home.

Alex (IT): Yep, will create and DM the label today. Once received, please confirm tracking. We'll remotely wipe the device after confirmation of receipt. Wipe window: within 72 hours of receipt.

Kelsey Harper: What about Adobe/Figma? Can accounts be transferred or do I just cancel? I have team assets in Figma files.

Marta (People Ops): For vendor apps: we try to transfer ownership where possible. Please add a team member as owner/transfer before you go. If you need help, tag @IT Ops or open a ticket and include the project links.

Ben (Payroll): PTO payout details: unused vacation will be paid out on the next payroll cycle after termination paperwork clears. Expect it in the payday following 4/15 payroll run. It will reflect standard tax withholdings. If you have specific deductions or 401k questions we can walk through.

Kelsey Harper: Who handles equity/vesting questions? I have RSUs that I think vest next month — worried about dates.

Marta (People Ops): Stock/vesting is handled by our Stock Admin / Legal. I'll loop in them via DM — they typically confirm final vesting run and any post-termination exercisability windows.

IT Ops: Heads up — SSO deprovision timeline: primary account deactivation scheduled for EOD of last business day (4/02). Exceptions (email forwarding, short-term access) can be granted for up to 7 days on a case-by-case basis; submit requests to it-requests@redwood.example with subject "handoff access - Kelsey".

Kelsey Harper: Would appreciate a 7-day forwarding for email if possible. A lot of external folks will still reach out.

Alex (IT): Noted. We'll leave email forwarding for 7 days. Please confirm desired forwarding address in DM.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Exit interview scheduling link sent to Kelsey via DM. Please complete the exit form before your last day.

Kelsey Harper: Got it — will fill out the form. Thanks everyone — appreciate the smooth handoff. :heart:

Marta (People Ops): You're welcome — we'll follow up in DMs with COBRA link, label, payroll contact, and stock admin contact. If anything changes, ping here. :thumbsup:
